entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: A powerful archmage over four thousand years old from Dominaria whose aging was slowed by a Fountain of Youth; he took part in the Ice Age, the Mending era and Dominaria United.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Jodah lives.

entities.name: Voska
entities.description: A wandering mage who apprenticed Jodah and gave him a Reflecting Mirror; executed by the Church of Tal.

entities.name: Reflecting Mirror
entities.description: A mirror Voska gave Jodah, in which he stored memories and which he smashed in Jaya's face.

entities.name: Church of Tal
entities.description: The dominant religious institution that believed magic to be evil and assaulted the Conclave of Mages.

entities.name: Sima
entities.description: A mage who travels with Jodah and later marries him; she died after the start of the Ice Age.

entities.name: Mairsil
entities.description: The ruler of the Conclave of Mages who placed his essence in a ruby ring.

entities.name: Lord Ith
entities.description: The former ruler of the Conclave imprisoned over the Bottomless Pit, driven insane and later brought to his senses by Jodah.

entities.name: Rag Man
entities.description: A man sent by Ith who took Jodah to the Conclave of Mages and died in Ith's rampage.

entities.name: Conclave of Mages
entities.description: The secluded community of mages that fell when Ith tore apart its building.

entities.name: School of the Unseen
entities.description: The school and community Jodah led, later destroyed by the War Beasts.

entities.name: Gerda Äagesdotter
entities.description: Jodah's second in command who kidnaps him with Gustha.

entities.name: Gustha Ebbasdotter
entities.description: The royal mage of Kjeldor who kidnaps Jodah and later helps stop the coup.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: A necromancer who imprisons Jodah and is merged with Mairsil through a ruby ring.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A former apprentice who rescues Jodah, is later possessed by Mairsil/Dûl, and ascends as a planeswalker.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A half-elven planeswalker who cures Jodah and enchanted his mirror to trigger the spark.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: The planeswalker behind Lim-Dûl's powers who cuts off his hand and takes him to Phyrexia.

entities.name: King Darien
entities.description: The Kjeldoran king convinced of Jodah's warnings.

entities.name: Knights of Stromgald
entities.description: The secret organization that staged a failed coup at Lim-Dûl's urging.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl's Battle
entities.description: The climactic clash between Lim-Dûl's undead hordes and the Kjeldoran-Balduvian alliance.

entities.name: Varchild
entities.description: A Kjeldoran who helped stop the coup and later became a renegade with anti-Balduvian sympathies.

entities.name: Soldev
entities.description: The place where the Soldevi Adnates activated the Phyrexian War Beasts and was leveled.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: The arch-enemy of Phyrexia whom Jodah restores to sanity.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: A fellow immortal human with whom Jodah began a relationship.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A planeswalker who reveals the threat of the New Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who works with Jodah on the Temporal Anchor.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: A planeswalker who works with Jodah on the Temporal Anchor.

entities.name: Kaya Cassir
entities.description: A planeswalker who works on the Temporal Anchor.

entities.name: Rona
entities.description: A Phyrexian pilot of a dragon engine whose forces wound Jodah.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders that Jodah helps fight in Dominaria United.

events.summary: Jodah bathes in a long-abandoned Fountain of Youth in Pitdown, slowing his aging to a crawl.
events.quote: The magical waters of this fountain slowed down his aging to a crawl

events.summary: Jodah is traded to the Rag Man and taken to the Conclave of Mages, where he passes Mairsil's test.
events.quote: Jodah succeeded in the test that Mairsil , the ruler of the Conclave, had set for him

events.summary: During a Church of Tal assault Jodah frees Ith, who rampages and kills Mairsil and the Rag Man, then is calmed by Jodah's mirror.
events.quote: Ith, who had been driven insane by his time over the Pit, go into a murderous rampage that resulted in the death of Mairsil and the Rag Man

events.summary: Ith tears apart the Conclave and the mages follow Jodah and Sima to the City of Shadows.
events.quote: the mages followed Jodah and Sima to the City of Shadows

events.summary: Jodah becomes Archmage and marries Sima, but outlives her and sinks into grief, storing his memories in his mirror.
events.quote: he began to store his memories in his mirror, wipe his memory clean, and then restore the memories from the mirror

events.summary: Gerda and Gustha kidnap Jodah and give him to Lim-Dûl, who imprisons him in Tresserhorn and clouds his mind with Fyndhorn Pollen.
events.quote: They gave him to the necromancer Lim-Dûl , who imprisoned Jodah in Tresserhorn

events.summary: Jaya Ballard rescues Jodah, and she calls upon Freyalise to cure him, putting them in the planeswalker's debt.
events.quote: Jaya called upon Freyalise to cure him

events.summary: Jodah and Jaya warn Kjeld; the Knights of Stromgald's coup fails and King Darien is convinced.
events.quote: the threat convinced King Darien of the truth in Jodah's warnings

events.summary: In Lim-Dûl's Battle, Jodah duels Lim-Dûl, until Leshrac cuts off Dûl's hand and takes him to Phyrexia.
events.quote: Leshrac took him to Phyrexia to be recreated

events.summary: Jodah's mirror is used in the World Spell that ends the Ice Age, and he disperses the effect through the safe havens, destroying them.
events.quote: Jodah was forced to disperse the effect of the spell through the safe havens , destroying them all

events.summary: Jaya shows Jodah Lim-Dûl's severed hand with the ring finger missing and they set out to find the ring.
events.quote: the hand of Lim-Dûl and the ring finger were missing

events.summary: At Soldev, Jaya, vessel of Mairsil/Dûl, stabs Jodah, and the Adnates use his blood to activate the War Beasts, which level Soldev and the School of the Unseen.
events.quote: Jaya stabbed Jodah fatally, revealing that she had been the new vessel of Mairsil/Dûl all along

events.summary: Jodah smashes his mirror in Jaya's face, burning away Mairsil and Lim-Dûl and triggering Jaya's spark.
events.quote: smashed his mirror in Jaya's face

events.summary: Jaya ascends as a planeswalker and helps defeat the Beasts; Jodah chooses not to rebuild the School and hides behind legends.
events.quote: Jodah opted to spread rumors and lies about himself to hide behind myths and legends

events.summary: Jodah helps restore Urza to sanity.
events.quote: played an important role in restoring Urza to sanity

events.summary: Jodah meets Jhoira at Urborg and joins her quest, beginning a relationship that did not work out.
events.quote: They began a relationship, but it didn't work out.

events.summary: Jodah presides over a peace summit between the Keldons and New Benalia, interrupted by Karn and Teferi revealing the New Phyrexian invasion.
events.quote: The summit was interrupted when the planeswalkers Karn and Teferi revealed the threat of a New Phyrexian invasion

events.summary: Jodah fights in the Battle at the Mana Rig as a leader of the New Coalition and delivers Jaya's eulogy.
events.quote: He helped create a memorial to Jaya after her death, and delivered her eulogy.

events.summary: Jodah gives Teferi, Saheeli and Kaya Urza's time machine blueprints and is grievously wounded defending the tower from Rona's forces.
events.quote: he was grievously wounded while helping protect the tower from Rona 's forces

relations.quote: Jodah was apprenticed at the age of 15 to the wandering mage Voska
eventually becoming the Archmage and marrying Sima
They gave him to the necromancer Lim-Dûl , who imprisoned Jodah in Tresserhorn
Jodah was saved by Jaya Ballard , a former apprentice

relations.note: the source of much of Dûl's powers
relations.quote: The planeswalker, who was the source behind much of Dûl's powers

relations.note: a relationship that didn't work out
relations.quote: They began a relationship, but it didn't work out.

relations.note: Archmage Eternal who oversaw the shift to the School
relations.quote: oversaw the shift from the City of Shadows to the School of the Unseen
